NO extra insect legs, wings, tail, extra horn, human face or transformation. Crisp original TV-cartoon black outlines, flat dark blue-gray/gunmetal panels with one shadow tone, not painterly. All bodies fully opaque. NO actual beams/projectiles, painted green fire, rays, aura, stars, trails, floor, shadows, dust, text or labels. True transparent background. Entire horn tips, fists and toes safely on canvas with25px clear gutters/margins. Desired upright figure height400-480px in1536x1024 or higher; make space for tall horn, never crop it.
